function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the
    spreadsheet or worksheet does not exist.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the
    spreadsheet or worksheet does not exist.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files
function.description:
Find files (including Google Sheets spreadsheets) in Google Drive by name.

Args:
    title: Text to find in file names (case-insensitive). Files whose name
        contains every word are returned first; if none do, files matching
        some of the words are returned ranked by matches with
        ``partial_match: true``. Omit to list all files.
    info: Alias for title.
    search_type: Zapier search type (accepted for compatibility).
    drive: Google Drive location (accepted for compatibility).
    folder: Only return files known to be in this folder ID.
    file_types: Only return these MIME types, e.g.
        "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet" or "spreadsheet".
    max_results: Maximum number of files to return (default 25).

Returns:
    JSON with ``results`` (id, title, mimeType), ``count`` returned and
    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the
    spreadsheet or worksheet does not exist.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the
    spreadsheet or worksheet does not exist.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).

    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and

    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

email, email delivery.

    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_update_row
function.description:
Update a spreadsheet row.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    row: Row ID to update, as returned in a row's row_id (required).
    drive: Google Drive location.
    background_color: Background color for the row.
    text_color: Text color for the row.
    text_format_bold: Bold text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_italic: Italic text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    text_format_strikethrough: Strikethrough text formatting (unchanged when omitted).
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs to update, e.g. '{"Name": "Jane"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated row details.

function.name: google_sheets_add_row
function.description:
Create a new row in a spreadsheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    timezone: Use spreadsheet timezone for date formatting.
    cells: JSON object of column name to value pairs, e.g. '{"Name": "John", "Age": "30"}',
        or a list of values in the worksheet's column order.
    values: Alias for cells.

Returns:
    JSON string with the created row (row_id and cells), or an error when the
    spreadsheet or worksheet does not exist.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files
function.description:
Find files (including Google Sheets spreadsheets) in Google Drive by name.

Args:
    title: Text to find in file names (case-insensitive). Files whose name
        contains every word are returned first; if none do, files matching
        some of the words are returned ranked by matches with
        ``partial_match: true``. Omit to list all files.
    info: Alias for title.
    search_type: Zapier search type (accepted for compatibility).
    drive: Google Drive location (accepted for compatibility).
    folder: Only return files known to be in this folder ID.
    file_types: Only return these MIME types, e.g.
        "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet" or "spreadsheet".
    max_results: Maximum number of files to return (default 25).

Returns:
    JSON with ``results`` (id, title, mimeType), ``count`` returned and
    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files
function.description:
Find files (including Google Sheets spreadsheets) in Google Drive by name.

Args:
    title: Text to find in file names (case-insensitive). Files whose name
        contains every word are returned first; if none do, files matching
        some of the words are returned ranked by matches with

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:

    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).

    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files
function.description:
Find files (including Google Sheets spreadsheets) in Google Drive by name.

Args:
    title: Text to find in file names (case-insensitive). Files whose name
        contains every word are returned first; if none do, files matching
        some of the words are returned ranked by matches with
        ``partial_match: true``. Omit to list all files.
    info: Alias for title.
    search_type: Zapier search type (accepted for compatibility).
    drive: Google Drive location (accepted for compatibility).
    folder: Only return files known to be in this folder ID.
    file_types: Only return these MIME types, e.g.
        "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet" or "spreadsheet".
    max_results: Maximum number of files to return (default 25).

Returns:
    JSON with ``results`` (id, title, mimeType), ``count`` returned and
    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files

    title: Text to find in file names (case-insensitive). Files whose name
        contains every word are returned first; if none do, files matching
        some of the words are returned ranked by matches with

    max_results: Maximum number of files to return (default 25).

Returns:
    JSON with ``results`` (id, title, mimeType), ``count`` returned and
    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id

recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id

Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.

        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_drive_find_multiple_files

    max_results: Maximum number of files to return (default 25).

    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

    channel: Channel ID or name.

    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email

Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:

    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:

    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

    ``total_count`` matching. An empty list means no file matched.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet

    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id

    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows

Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more

    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows

Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more

    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id

    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).

    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.
    drive: Google Drive location.
    output_format: "raw_rows" returns headers plus value lists; any other
        value (all/rows/formatted_rows) returns column-name objects.
    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

Returns:
    JSON string with rows.

function.name: google_sheets_find_worksheet
function.description:
Find a worksheet by title (or ID) in a spreadsheet.

Titles match case-insensitively. When spreadsheet is omitted, the
worksheet is looked up across all spreadsheets and returned if unique.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    title: Worksheet title (or ID) to search for (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    drive: Google Drive location.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching worksheet.

function.name: google_sheets_get_spreadsheet_by_id
function.description:
Get a spreadsheet and its worksheets by ID or title.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    includeGridData: Also return each worksheet's first 20 rows (row_id and
        cells) with its total row_count. Use google_sheets_get_many_rows or
        google_sheets_find_many_rows for more rows.

Returns:
    JSON string with spreadsheet details and worksheets (id, title, headers).

function.name: gmail_send_email
function.description:
Send an email via Gmail.

Composes and delivers a new outgoing Gmail message to one or more
recipients. Use this to send (not draft) an email — the message is
transmitted immediately and appears in the recipient's inbox. Handles
outbound email dispatch, reply-and-send, forward-and-send, notification
emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

Keywords: gmail send email, gmail send mail, gmail compose and send,
send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit
email, dispatch email, email send, gmail sender, mail send, gmail
message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert
email, email delivery.

Note: this SENDS the email. For drafts use gmail_create_draft instead.

Args:
    to: Recipient email address(es), comma-separated for multiple.
    subject: Email subject line.
    body: Email body content (plain text or HTML).
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string confirming the sent message: id, thread_id, subject and
    recipients (the body is not echoed back).
