function.name: google_calendar_find_calendars
function.description:
Find calendars matching criteria.

Args:
    showHidden: Include hidden calendars in results.
    showDeleted: Include deleted calendars in results.
    minAccessRole: Only include calendars with at least this access level.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching calendars.

function.name: google_calendar_find_event
function.description:
Find events matching search criteria.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    search_term: Search term to match against event fields (optional).
                 Searches summary, description, location, and attendees.
                 If not provided, returns all events matching date filters.
    start_time: Minimum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
                on or after this time.
    end_time: Maximum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
              on or before this time.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching events.

function.name: zoom_list_meetings
function.description: List Zoom meetings (offline simulation).

function.name: zoom_find_meeting
function.description:
Find a meeting or webinar by ID or topic.

Args:
    type: Meeting type (1=Meeting, 2=Webinar).
    id: Meeting ID to search for.
    topic: Meeting topic to search for.
    isExactMatch: If True, only exact topic matches are returned.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching meeting(s).

function.name: google_calendar_update_event
function.description:
Update an existing calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    eventid: Event ID to update (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    start__dateTime: Start date and time.
    end__dateTime: End date and time.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses (replaces existing).
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).

Returns:
    JSON string with updated event details.

function.name: google_calendar_find_event
function.description:
Find events matching search criteria.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    search_term: Search term to match against event fields (optional).
                 Searches summary, description, location, and attendees.
                 If not provided, returns all events matching date filters.
    start_time: Minimum time filter (optional). Returns events starting

    end_time: Maximum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
              on or before this time.

    JSON string with matching events.

function.name: google_calendar_update_event
function.description:
Update an existing calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    eventid: Event ID to update (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    start__dateTime: Start date and time.

    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.

    colorId: Event color ID.

    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).

Returns:
    JSON string with updated event details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: google_calendar_find_calendars
function.description:
Find calendars matching criteria.

Args:
    showHidden: Include hidden calendars in results.
    showDeleted: Include deleted calendars in results.
    minAccessRole: Only include calendars with at least this access level.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching calendars.

function.name: google_calendar_find_event
function.description:
Find events matching search criteria.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    search_term: Search term to match against event fields (optional).
                 Searches summary, description, location, and attendees.
                 If not provided, returns all events matching date filters.
    start_time: Minimum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
                on or after this time.
    end_time: Maximum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
              on or before this time.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching events.

function.name: zoom_list_meetings
function.description: List Zoom meetings (offline simulation).

function.name: zoom_find_meeting
function.description:
Find a meeting or webinar by ID or topic.

Args:
    type: Meeting type (1=Meeting, 2=Webinar).
    id: Meeting ID to search for.
    topic: Meeting topic to search for.
    isExactMatch: If True, only exact topic matches are returned.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching meeting(s).

function.name: google_calendar_update_event
function.description:

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).

function.name: google_calendar_find_calendars
function.description:
Find calendars matching criteria.

Args:
    showHidden: Include hidden calendars in results.
    showDeleted: Include deleted calendars in results.
    minAccessRole: Only include calendars with at least this access level.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching calendars.

function.name: google_calendar_find_event
function.description:
Find events matching search criteria.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    search_term: Search term to match against event fields (optional).
                 Searches summary, description, location, and attendees.
                 If not provided, returns all events matching date filters.
    start_time: Minimum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
                on or after this time.
    end_time: Maximum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
              on or before this time.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching events.

function.name: zoom_list_meetings
function.description: List Zoom meetings (offline simulation).

function.name: zoom_find_meeting
function.description:
Find a meeting or webinar by ID or topic.

Args:
    type: Meeting type (1=Meeting, 2=Webinar).
    id: Meeting ID to search for.
    topic: Meeting topic to search for.
    isExactMatch: If True, only exact topic matches are returned.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching meeting(s).

function.name: google_calendar_update_event
function.description:
Update an existing calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    eventid: Event ID to update (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    start__dateTime: Start date and time.
    end__dateTime: End date and time.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses (replaces existing).
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).

Returns:
    JSON string with updated event details.

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: google_calendar_find_calendars
function.description:
Find calendars matching criteria.

Args:
    showHidden: Include hidden calendars in results.
    showDeleted: Include deleted calendars in results.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching calendars.

function.name: google_calendar_find_event
function.description:
Find events matching search criteria.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    search_term: Search term to match against event fields (optional).
                 Searches summary, description, location, and attendees.
                 If not provided, returns all events matching date filters.
    start_time: Minimum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
                on or after this time.
    end_time: Maximum time filter (optional). Returns events starting
              on or before this time.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching events.

function.name: zoom_list_meetings
function.description: List Zoom meetings (offline simulation).

function.name: zoom_find_meeting
function.description:
Find a meeting or webinar by ID or topic.

Args:
    type: Meeting type (1=Meeting, 2=Webinar).
    id: Meeting ID to search for.
    topic: Meeting topic to search for.
    isExactMatch: If True, only exact topic matches are returned.

Returns:
    JSON string with matching meeting(s).

function.name: google_calendar_update_event
function.description:
Update an existing calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    eventid: Event ID to update (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    start__dateTime: Start date and time.
    end__dateTime: End date and time.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses (replaces existing).
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).

Returns:
    JSON string with updated event details.

function.name: slack_send_channel_message
function.description:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Args:
    channel: Channel ID or name.
    text: Message text.
    add_app_to_channel: Whether to auto-add Zapier app to channel (default True).
    as_bot: Whether to send as a bot (default True).
    username: Bot name to use (if sending as bot).
    icon: Bot icon (URL or emoji like :robot_face:).
    add_edit_link: Whether to include link to this Zap (default True).
    image_url: URL of image to attach.
    unfurl: Whether to auto-expand links (default True).
    link_names: Whether to link @mentions (default True).
    post_at: Schedule message for later (ISO datetime).
    thread_ts: Parent message timestamp if replying to a thread.
    reply_broadcast: Also send thread reply to channel (default False).

Returns:
    JSON string with sent message details.

    agenda: New meeting agenda/description.

Returns:
    JSON string with updated meeting details.

function.name: google_sheets_get_many_rows
function.description:
Get multiple rows from a worksheet.

Args:
    spreadsheet: Spreadsheet ID or title (required).
    worksheet: Worksheet ID or title (required).
    spreadsheet_id: Alias for spreadsheet.
    worksheet_id: Alias for worksheet.
    range: Columns (and optionally rows) to include, e.g. "A:Z" or "A2:C40".
    row_count: Maximum number of rows to return; total_count and has_more
        report whether more rows exist.

    first_row: First row number to retrieve.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_get_email_by_id
function.description:
Get a specific email by its message ID.

Args:
    message_id: The unique ID of the email message to retrieve.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal").

Returns:
    JSON string with the message details, or error if not found.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_get_email_by_id
function.description:
Get a specific email by its message ID.

Args:
    message_id: The unique ID of the email message to retrieve.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal").

Returns:
    JSON string with the message details, or error if not found.

function.name: google_calendar_create_detailed_event
function.description:
Create a detailed calendar event.

    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    start__dateTime: Start date and time (required).
    end__dateTime: End date and time (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

Args:
    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).

    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: google_calendar_create_detailed_event
function.description:
Create a detailed calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    start__dateTime: Start date and time (required).
    end__dateTime: End date and time (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.

function.description:

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.description:

    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).

    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_get_email_by_id
function.description:
Get a specific email by its message ID.

Args:
    message_id: The unique ID of the email message to retrieve.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal").

Returns:
    JSON string with the message details, or error if not found.

function.name: google_calendar_create_detailed_event
function.description:
Create a detailed calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    start__dateTime: Start date and time (required).
    end__dateTime: End date and time (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

Args:
    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).
    to: Override recipients, comma-separated.
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_get_email_by_id
function.description:
Get a specific email by its message ID.

Args:
    message_id: The unique ID of the email message to retrieve.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal").

Returns:
    JSON string with the message details, or error if not found.

function.name: google_calendar_create_detailed_event
function.description:
Create a detailed calendar event.

Args:
    calendarid: Calendar ID (required).
    start__dateTime: Start date and time (required).
    end__dateTime: End date and time (required).
    summary: Event title/summary.
    description: Event description.
    location: Event location.
    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.

function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,

        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).
    to: Override recipients, comma-separated.
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

Args:
    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).
    to: Override recipients, comma-separated.
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

Args:
    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).
    to: Override recipients, comma-separated.
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: gmail_find_email
function.description:
Search for emails using Gmail search operators, newest first.

Args:
    query: Gmail search query. Supports operators: from:, to:, cc:,
        subject:, label:, in:, is:unread, is:read, is:starred,
        has:attachment, after:YYYY/MM/DD, before:YYYY/MM/DD, -term, OR,
        and plain text (e.g., "from:user@example.com is:unread"). Terms are
        ANDed; AND binds more tightly than OR; parentheses group expressions.
        Quoted phrases stay together. Brace/field-scoped groups are unsupported.
    id: Message ID for direct lookup (returns single message).
    label: Filter by label (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT").
    max_results: Maximum number of results to return.
    include_spam_trash: Include spam and trash in results.
    format: Email format to return ("full", "metadata", "minimal", "raw").

Returns:
    JSON string with matching messages (newest first), result_count
    returned and total_count matching.

function.name: gmail_reply_to_email
function.description:
Reply to an existing email thread.

Args:
    thread_id: Thread ID to reply to (required).
    body: Content of the reply (required).
    to: Override recipients, comma-separated.
    cc: CC recipients, comma-separated.
    bcc: BCC recipients, comma-separated.
    from_: Sender email address (alias).
    from_name: Display name for sender.
    reply_to: Reply-to email address.
    subject: Override subject line.
    body_type: Body format - "plain" or "html" (default: "plain").
    signature: Email signature to append.
    label_ids: Comma-separated label IDs to apply.
    file: File to attach (URL or path).

Returns:
    JSON string with reply message details.

function.name: zoom_create_meeting

Create a new Zoom meeting or webinar.

Args:
    type: Meeting type (1=Meeting, 2=Webinar).
    topic: Meeting topic/title.
    host_email: Host email address.
    start_time: Start time in ISO format.
    duration: Duration in minutes (default 60).
    timezone: Timezone (default America/Los_Angeles).
    agenda: Meeting agenda/description.
    registration_required: Whether registration is required.
    approval_type: Approval type (0=auto, 1=manual, 2=none required).
    passcode: Meeting passcode.
    settings_waiting_room: Whether waiting room is enabled.

Returns:
    JSON string with created meeting details.

    conferencing: Add video conferencing link.
    recurrence_frequency: Repeat frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
    recurrence_until: Repeat until date.
    recurrence_count: Number of times to repeat.
    all_day: Whether this is an all-day event.
    colorId: Event color ID.
    attendees: List of attendee email addresses.
    visibility: Event visibility (default/public/private).
    reminders__useDefault: Use calendar default reminders.
    reminders_methods: Reminder methods (email/popup).
    reminders_minutes: Minutes before event for reminders.
    transparency: Show as free (transparent) or busy (opaque).
    guestsCanModify: Whether guests can modify event.
    eventType: Type of event (default/outOfOffice).

Returns:
    JSON string with created event details.
